import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*x+params[3]*x**2+params[4]*v+params[5]*x*v+params[6]*x*x*v
            +params[7]*s+params[8]*np.cos(x)*c+params[9]*np.sin(x)*c)
